div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Rose HR Mobile App
[Software System]
Flutter app (Android / iOS).
Attendance punching, shift summaries,
HR requests and manager approvals.
English + Arabic (RTL)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Rose HR Backend
[External System]
Odoo-style JSON-RPC HTTP API.
Source of truth for employees,
attendance, shifts, requests
and end-of-service data

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Firebase Cloud Messaging
[External System]
Delivers push notifications for
request status updates
and approvals

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

[External System]

auto-detect the working timezone
(Egypt / Saudi Arabia)
